name: F1 merchandise
about: Racing caps and small accessories with the Formula 1 Monaco Grand Prix branding. The street circuit in Monaco is one of the most famous races on the F1 calendar.
tip: Buy these at the official shop, since the branding is the authentic version.

name: Orange liqueur
where: La Distillerie de Monaco, La Condamine
about: L'Orangerie, a liqueur made with local bitter oranges. It is a product of the Principality's own distillery.
tip: Look for the local bitter orange version, which is the one made in Monaco.
